summary: Ascendis Pharma filed a Form 6-K reporting the grant of 31,250 warrants to employees under its Articles of Association. Each warrant has an exercise price of $237.65, equal to the closing price on the grant date. Vesting is 25% after one year, with the remainder vesting monthly over three years, subject to continued service. This is an ordinary employee equity grant with no special-situation characteristics such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. No transaction terms, board recommendations, or advisors are involved. This is a routine compensation filing that does not constitute a special situation.
